extensions.name: DOM Taint Tracker
extensions.summary: Static DOM-XSS taint analysis on served HTML/JS with one-hop dataflow: connects sources (location.*, referrer, window.name, postMessage, storage) to sinks (innerHTML, eval, document.write, setTimeout, location-nav) and emits findings. The proxy-side answer to Burp DOM Invader.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: AWS SigV4 Signer
extensions.summary: Auto-signs outgoing requests to *.amazonaws.com with AWS Signature v4.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

service.desc: Override; auto-detected from host if blank

extensions.name: Identity Rotator
extensions.summary: Per-host sticky rotation of User-Agent / Accept-Language / Sec-CH-UA across realistic browser profiles.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Hackvertor
extensions.summary: Inline <@tag>..<@/tag> transforms resolved on outgoing requests: base64/url/hex/html encode+decode, sha256/sha1, upper/lower/reverse, timestamp, random, uuid, repeat. A proxy-side port of Gareth Heyes' Hackvertor -- keep payloads readable, let the tag do the encoding on the wire. Tags nest, innermost-first.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Collaborator Everywhere
extensions.summary: Decorates outbound traffic with OAST canaries in the headers servers tend to trust (X-Forwarded-For/Host, Referer, True-Client-IP, ...) to surface blind SSRF and out-of-band interactions. A port of James Kettle's Collaborator Everywhere, wired to Nullock's own OAST sink. Default-OFF: a no-op until you set oastDomain.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

oastDomain.desc: Your OAST sink domain (see DEPLOY_OAST.md); BLANK disables all injection

onlyHosts.desc: Restrict injection to these hosts (exact or *.suffix); empty = every host but the OAST domain

maxPerHost.desc: Cap canary injections per host so a crawl doesn't spray thousands of tokens

extensions.name: OAuth / OIDC Auditor
extensions.summary: Passively audits the OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect dance: implicit flow (response_type=token), missing state (CSRF), missing PKCE, tokens leaking into request URLs or 3xx Location headers, and cleartext redirect_uri. Covers the flow around the token that Nullock's native JWT checks don't. Observe-only, no permission.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: SAML Auditor
extensions.summary: Grabs the base64 SAMLResponse/SAMLRequest out of an IdP auto-POST form, decodes it (POST binding), and flags unsigned assertions, XML comment-injection surface (CVE-2017-11427 class), over-long validity windows, missing InResponseTo/Destination, and cleartext ACS endpoints. The passive-detection half of SAML Raider. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Source Map Exposure
extensions.summary: Flags exposed JavaScript/CSS source maps: a served asset referencing an external .map, an inline data: source map, or a .map served directly with sourcesContent (confirmed original-source leak). The starting point of every 'unpack the webpack bundle' recon workflow. Observe-only, no permission.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: ViewState Auditor
extensions.summary: Decodes ASP.NET __VIEWSTATE from served forms and flags the unencrypted case (ObjectStateFormatter marker + readable content): state is exposed, and a deserialization/RCE surface if EnableViewStateMac is off (ysoserial.net). Notes __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR presence. Encrypted ViewState is left alone. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: CSRF Auditor
extensions.summary: Scans served HTML for state-changing POST forms that appear to lack an anti-CSRF token (by field name or token-shaped hidden value). Same-origin forms only; GET forms ignored. A proxy-side CSRF Scanner that complements Nullock's native SameSite-cookie checks. Heuristic -- findings are review leads. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin
